description: A restoration needs a synthetic that passes the optional's own test. The second synthetic sounds ta, so c's [T="other"] can neither restore it nor read it, and only the chosen a remains (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T="ta"] [T="ta"]
%rule b A [T] [T] [T]
%rule c A T [T="other"]
